title: Characterization of tree-child networks in terms of mu vectors
summary: We characterize tree-child phylogenetic networks in terms of their mu-representations. First, we give a structural characterization of tree-child networks by means of ordered tree-path decompositions. We then translate this decomposition into a set of purely vectorial conditions on finite subsets M in N^n. We prove that such a set M is the mu-representation of a tree-child phylogenetic network if and only if it is tree-child mu-compatible.
